description: Source code for the FrontPanel plugin, implementing API methods for controlling front panel indicators, LEDs, clock, and display patterns, including event handling and configuration management.

classes.name: FrontPanel
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing front panel control API, event handling, and configuration.

classes.name: TestPatternInfo
classes.description: Helper class for managing LED text pattern updates.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, registers API methods, and starts necessary services.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of a specified front panel indicator.

methods.name: getBrightness
methods.description: Retrieves the current brightness of the front panel indicator.

methods.name: powerLedOn
methods.description: Turns on a specified LED indicator.

methods.name: powerLedOff
methods.description: Turns off a specified LED indicator.

methods.name: setClockBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of the clock display, if enabled.

methods.name: getClockBrightness
methods.description: Gets the current clock display brightness.

methods.name: getFrontPanelLights
methods.description: Returns a list of controllable front panel lights.

methods.name: getFrontPanelLightsInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed info about each front panel light.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Sets properties of a specific LED.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Configures blinking pattern for an LED.

methods.name: is24HourClock
methods.description: Checks if 24-hour clock format is enabled.

methods.name: setClockTestPattern
methods.description: Displays a test pattern on the clock display.

methods.name: updateLedTextPattern
methods.description: Updates the LED display with a text pattern.
